purpose: 공식 자료와 공개 커뮤니티 후보의 최소 provenance 정렬 계약 — 안전 판단·위험 신호·지도 렌더링 계약이 아님
separation_rule: source_class, access_decision, review_state, and eligibility_state must not be inferred across source types; official provenance does not validate a community candidate, and community experience does not validate an official dataset.
render_rule: This contract grants no rendering permission. Any later display requires separate aggregation, expression, provenance, and independent Red gates.
